spec.query:
from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "${sensor}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "temperatura")

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "sensor_003")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "estado")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value:
        if r._value == "normal" then 0
        else if r._value == "aviso" then 1
        else if r._value == "alerta" then 2
        else -1
  }))

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "${sensor}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "${metric}")

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "sensor_003")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "atividade_movimento")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value:
        if r._value == "sem movimento" then 0
        else if r._value == "movimento detetado" then 1
        else if r._value == "atividade elevada" then 2
        else -1
  }))

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "${metric}")

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "${sensor}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "humidade")

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "${sensor}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "${metric}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Valor: r._value,
      Estado:
        if float(v: r._value) < float(v: ${min_threshold}) then "ABAIXO DO LIMITE"
        else if float(v: r._value) > float(v: ${max_threshold}) then "ACIMA DO LIMITE"
        else "NORMAL"
  }))

from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor_id"] == "${sensor}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "${metric}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value:
        if float(v: r._value) < float(v: ${min_threshold}) then "ABAIXO DO LIMITE"
        else if float(v: r._value) > float(v: ${max_threshold}) then "ACIMA DO LIMITE"
        else "NORMAL"
  }))
